answer: Like a slow-moving glacier carving granite, decentralized consensus compacts peer-attested compute into enduring trust. Ephemeral identities fracture against this weight; valid work crystallizes like an opal under geological pressure, while each peer's verified pulse anchors rhythmic state transitions. Proof of Agent enforces a superlinear staking penalty, where forging pseudonyms scales attacker costs quadratically ($O(N^2)$).
